neon.missingFunctionsMetricsReason: Official plans documentation explicitly excludes Neon Functions from Console usage summaries. The Free billing page has no usage invoice control (View/Pay invoices disabled). Official consumption v2 requires an eligible paid plan and lists no Functions active/wait/invocation metric. No supported Free read path for those remaining counters was established.
scopeCaveats: The organization list is not an audit of all projects across every account organization; it cannot prove account-wide Functions headroom.
Console says metrics may be delayed by one hour and are not updated for inactive projects.
Rounded database metrics must not be substituted for Functions metrics.

cloudflare.missingPagesBuildMetricsReason: The account Workers & Pages Usage/View limits shows Workers requests, observability and Workers build minutes, not a Pages monthly build counter. Project Deployments lists deployments and Metrics contains function request charts, not the account monthly Pages build meter. The public Pages API documentation inspected lists project/deployment endpoints without a remaining-build counter. Therefore neither zero usage nor 500-minus-project-deployments is asserted.
scopeCaveats: Workers build minutes are not Pages build usage.
Deployment count is not established as billing quota consumption, especially for prebuilt Direct Upload, and account includes another existing project.
This review did not establish whether Direct Upload deployments debit the monthly built-in build allowance.
